hero.description: Therapeutic and wellness massage in Cagliari to ease body tension and calm the mind.

about.paragraph1: As a Sardinian therapeutic massage practitioner with 17+ years of experience, I support clients with a results-driven approach focused on recovery, mobility, and long-term well-being.
about.paragraph2: My career between Paris and Sardinia has built a complete skill set combining advanced manual techniques, deep tissue work, and energy-based care tailored to each client.
about.paragraph3: Each session starts with a structured assessment to define a precise and safe treatment plan aligned with your health and performance goals.
